headline: Study on making Holyoke High North, Dean Campus and Opportunities Academy separate schools, plus superintendent evaluation and educator retention.
summary: Work starts on the superintendent's evaluation and goals for the 26-27 academic year. A report on new educator induction, mentoring, and turnover is also on the agenda.
items: Begin superintendent evaluation and goal development for the 26-27 academic year, ordered by Chair Dr. Rivera-Colon
Review DESE superintendent rubric, DESE evaluation guidance, sample self-assessment and goal setting, and district benchmarks and project plans

Study the benefits and challenges of making Holyoke High North, Holyoke High Dean Campus, and Opportunities Academy three separate independent schools, due January 2027, ordered by Member Sheehan on June 22, 2026

Superintendent report on educator induction and mentoring/onboarding, including alignment with June 2025 DESE guidelines, three years of new educator retention and turnover data, and recommendations, ordered on February 9, 2026
location: Media Center, Holyoke High School North, 500 Beech St, Holyoke
plain_text:
CITY OF HOLYOKE
SCHOOL COMMITTEE
Leadership and Accountability Subcommittee Agenda
DATE: August 5, 2026
TIME: 6:00 PM
LOCATION: Media Center, Holyoke High School North, 500 Beech St, Holyoke
On March 29, 2025 Governor Maura Healey signed into law bodies to H.62, as amended by
S.2506 (which contains the final form of the bill), entitled "An act Relative to Extending Certain
Covid-19 Measures Adopted during the State of Emergency" ("ACT). Of interest to all
governmental public bodies in Massachusetts, the Act extends until June, 2027, the authority
for meetings of multiple-member bodies to be held in an entirely remote or hybrid format. All
public bodies may hold fully remote or hybrid meetings, without the physical presence of a
quorum of the public body, as long as "adequate, alternative means" of public access is also
provided.
Members of the public can access the meeting here:
https://hps-holyoke-ma-us.zoom.us/j/85287777627
Or by phone by calling (301) 715-8592 and then providing Meeting ID Web 852 8777 7627. No
passcode is required.
CALL TO ORDER ~ ROLL CALL ~ PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE Pursuant to M.G.L. c. 30A, s.
20, I am hereby informing all attendees that a video and audio recording is being made of the
meeting.
NEW BUSINESS
Order filed by Chair Dr. Rivera-Colon that the Leadership and Accountability subcommittee
meet with the Superintendent to begin evaluation and goal development for the 26-27
academic year.
DESE Superintendent Rubric
DESE Guidance on Evaluating the Superintendent
Sample Self Assessment and Goal Setting
District Benchmarks and Project Plans
June 22, 2026 Order filed by School Committee Member Sheehan that the administration study
the benefits and challenges of returning Holyoke High North, Holyoke High Dean Campus and
Opportunities Academy as three separate independent schools. The report should be
completed and presented by January 2027.
Feb 9, 2026 That the Superintendent provide a report to the School Committee on the district's
current educator induction and mentoring/onboarding practices, including;
How our program aligns with the June 2025 DESE Guidelines for Induction and Mentoring
Programs and the state's induction requirements.
Three years of available data on new educator retention and turnover, broken up by school,
role, and demographic group, highlighting areas of highest attrition.
The superintendent's recommendation for strengthening induction, mentoring, and onboarding
as key strategies to improve early-career educator support and reduce turnover, particularly in
schools and subject areas experiencing the greatest staffing instability.
OLD BUSINESS
None
Next Meeting: September 2, 2026, Media Center, HHS Campus
